If you are suffering you are treated like a nuisance and it is so disheartening. And still my medical issues are unaddressed and there is no care or support from these doctors. I am looking to join another surgery after being with this doctors all my life - it was such a kinder place when Dr Eccles ran the surgery - now the doctors do not even try to hide their contempt and suspicion of their patients.

Current partners of this surgery treat healthcare like a business model and the doctors they are hiring reflect this cold, one in one out attitude - there is no warmth or compassion in the experiences I have had with doctors recently - as a neurodivergent woman i am disgusted this practice has a neurodivergent friendly accreditation - the doctors adopt an archaic, deferential approach in which they will tell you the healthcare you will receive rather than the modern, collaborative, compassionate approach adopted in quality healthcare facilities in the 21st century.

The doctors will not treat you in the context of your neurodivergence and will instead force treatments only suitable for neurotypical brains - even if presented with guidelines and evidence based research showing their medical advice is outdated and such treatments not effective for neurodiverse population - their solution is: ‘tough’. The doctors are archaic and bizarre.

There is a lack of cohesion at this surgery - doctors seem so uninterested they do not even read notes and so time is wasted repeating the same issues to different doctors, sometimes on the same day and still no follow up for medical issues are ever given. For me personally, it feels like negligence and though I have complained to the practice manager it took PALS and other third parties to intervene for any response and now another cycle of negligence and lack of care is repeating, I realise its time for me to leave.

Dealing with this surgery adds to my stress and triggers my ptsd. You tell them people you love have died they quickly quip ‘sorry for your loss, anyway’ the doctors’ lack of interest and care, borders on inhumane.

I am thankful for some of the kind receptionists here but feel so sorry for them - working for such cold, unkind, target driven partners they must have to bear the brunt of the terrible service patients are receiving here right now.

There is a strong feeling of contempt  these partners and doctors seem to hold against the local working class community they are here to support - they seem disgusted with their own patients - and suspicious of them - at the moment there is a bizarre system in place in which junior doctors consult the almighty powerful wizards of oz aka the partners for anything and everything - then ‘computer says no’ - the wizard of oz and his minions. This system is very revealing of the hierarchical culture of this place in which patients, doctors and partners are treated like islands standing alone - it feels childish, power hungry and outdated and I personally will have nothing more to do
